alternatives.choice: Embed JAX/jaxlib/XLA architecture as production computation
Drop extension/compiler APIs because spelling or implementation differs

decisions.recommendation: Retain tracing/IR/control effects, custom AD/batching rules, JIT/AOT, extension/lowering and portable export semantics. Implement typed first-party Coeus program transformations; Hephaestus owns native target lowering, Moirai execution. Treat documented XLA/MLIR/Pallas interfaces as functional language/format contracts, preserving behavior through first-party representations rather than embedding a third-party runtime.
decisions.remaining_work: Approve concrete IR/effect/target-language design and map each extension signature, output artifact and error. Native kernel/lowering groups are source-linked routing, not an approved compiler implementation.
decisions.title: First-party transforms, compiler and target interfaces

alternatives.choice: Always widen every reduced-precision array operation
Always compute arange explicit step in output T and call it equivalent

decisions.recommendation: Preserve native declared-T default arithmetic. For the frozen arange explicit-step low-precision contract, derive the reference rounding algorithm and encode any necessary working precision as an explicit, justified numerical policy; alternatively reproduce the reference rounding through a native implementation with proved equivalence. Do not hide widening in a generic kernel or silently drop the low-precision variant.
decisions.remaining_work: Materialize dtype-by-branch rounding witnesses and a reviewed policy. If no policy satisfies both the required reference observable behavior and native-T constraints, surface that specific irreconcilable case to the program owner; this audit does not approve a widening exception.
decisions.title: Explicit comparator precision versus native arithmetic

alternatives.choice: Exclude refs/stateful APIs because the workspace favors functional code
Treat callbacks/effects as no-op tracing metadata

decisions.recommendation: Retain refs, stateful PRNG, callbacks, ordered effects and donation/aliasing as public functional-equivalence contracts. Represent state transition, ownership and effect order explicitly through typed program/actor/resource boundaries. Pure array update APIs retain value semantics; source compiler in-place optimization is not user-visible mutation permission.
decisions.remaining_work: Define AD/JIT/vmap effect admissibility and negative contracts, resource lifetime/cancellation and callback failure propagation at each signature.
decisions.title: Effectful APIs under functional workspace boundaries

alternatives.choice: Remove Compiled.__call__ because autodoc may obtain only a generic metaclass docstring
Assume Compiled call accepts all transforms because ordinary jitted functions do

decisions.recommendation: Implement trace/lower/compile/call specialization and explicitly reject AD, vmap and jit on already AOT-compiled functions in the circumstances documented by the frozen reference. Preserve these rejection contracts as tested parity obligations. Compiled.__call__ is a documented callable workflow even though its individual getter lacks an own docstring.
decisions.remaining_work: Define valid specializations, compile/call mismatch errors, all transformed rejection cases, donation/liveness and compiler-analysis availability.
decisions.title: AOT invocation and transform rejection

alternatives.choice: Use silent host fallback or omit unavailable devices
Treat an unbounded dependency requirement as an exact environment pin

decisions.recommendation: Keep frozen JAX 0.12.0.1. Resolve a current coherent reference oracle environment within its actual dependency requirements, recording exact JAX/jaxlib/NumPy/ml_dtypes/plugin/compiler/driver/hardware hashes and numerical configuration. Companion reexports and generated/native signatures remain unresolved until their exact artifacts are selected. Device absence blocks qualification, not the inventory.
decisions.remaining_work: 25 external reexport signatures and generated/native constructors/objects require source/artifact evidence. No runtime installation or execution is performed by this lane.
decisions.title: Reference companion and target qualification

alternatives.choice: Assume serialization and calling-convention versions are the same

decisions.recommendation: Retain jax.export.minimum_supported_serialization_version and maximum_supported_serialization_version as documented obligations. The frozen public export module has neither a binding nor __all__ entry. Resolve exact tagged release-artifact behavior and intended semantic contract; do not replace them with similarly named calling-convention constants or delete them as unsupported.
decisions.remaining_work: Characterize missing-binding/attribute behavior and locate authoritative versioned serialization contract without retrying the stopped docs route.
decisions.title: Source declaration/export drift

alternatives.choice: A statistical distribution test alone proves deterministic key semantics
Assume cross-version/back-end bitstream identity promised by compatibility policy

decisions.recommendation: Keep typed/legacy keys, split/fold-in/clone, stateful APIs and extension PRNGs. Distinguish distributional correctness from exact frozen implementation/backend bitstreams. Record implementation selection and configuration; preserve both positive distribution/property evidence and required bitstream witnesses.
decisions.remaining_work: Map each generator, state/key type and device with deterministic and distributional test obligations; quantify statistical tests analytically before execution.
